POWER MECHANICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

2. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.

15. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
